_note: Section catalogue entry (D-042, D-060, D-076). Content: it changes no number. Figures, rates, dates and section numbers never appear in text (SC-2); availability and history are derived from rule versions, never authored (SC-4). s.516 covers both amounts in one sentence; the 1961 Act splits them into ss.288A and 288B, so there is one entry per amount (SC-1 counts the sections an entry's provisions cite).
_sources: provisions: RATE-ROUND-PAYABLE.json (1961 s.288B; 2025 s.516). summary: S2 s.516 ("any amount payable or refundable"); 1961 s.288B ("Any amount payable, and the amount of refund due"); 01-rulebook.md RATE-ROUND-003 (the final amount). routes[0]: RATE-ROUND-PAYABLE. A refund's rounding direction is ROUND-NEG-001, STATUS UNCLEAR, so the summary does not describe it. No disqualifiers: s.516 has no exception.
plainName: Rounding off the tax you pay or the refund you get
summary: The final amount you pay, or the refund due to you, is rounded to the nearest multiple of {{RATE-ROUND-PAYABLE.toNearest}} rupees. Paise are dropped first, and then the amount goes up if its last figure is five or more and down otherwise. This is the last step of the computation.

routes.name: Always applied
routes.description: Nothing to claim or choose: the rounded figure is the amount payable or refundable.
